title: Before a lane's push, the guard runs the lane lint's fast checks on the commits it sends
why: The lane lint runs only after a lane's push, so the silent-undo check failed #1759 after it was pushed (lane lane-finds-triage, session_013NEJL3ixw3qjVWMvVLFtg5, relayed by the coordinator 08:12 CST Nov 8). The same class sent #2032's test commit out with no Red-run line. Each such gap after a push costs a replacement PR, since a force push is the owner's act.
note: Coordinator's proposal, 08:12 CST Nov 8: run `merge --lane-lint`, or its fast checks, before a lane's push. Not folded into red-run-pre-push: that step checks one trailer and its lane is mid-build. This step is the general home. It extends the same push-time hook that red-run-pre-push (Red-run line) and lint-before-record-push (STE lint) extend, and it calls the lane lint's own check list rather than a copy (building-one-home-per-capability). Scope question for the lane: which lane-lint checks are fast enough for every push. The record states the cost per push (process starts, reads) and a test proves it. Done check: a red test where a push that sends a commit the silent-undo check fails is refused before it leaves. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). Filed by triage 08:13 CST Nov 8. Started by the coordinator 08:14 CST Nov 8 in lane session_013NEJL2RXfa7QBPNAXaXgp4, built on #1582's hook. Lane pick 10:49 CST Nov 8: keep the commit-plus-push refusal (item 431 withdrawn 10:51 CST: the pick can be undone, so it is the lane's); debt lane-lint-chain-blanket-deny. Lane 11:25 CST Nov 8: the debt is renamed lane-lint-chain-refusal (the glossary check refuses the old word); its record says the refusal is kept as the lane's call (item 423 ruling). Incidents #2077 refuses (lane notes-fix-reverify-large, 11:29 CST Nov 8): #1597 (merge f7737da9b, docs/decisions/ci-job-caps.md) and #1668 (merge 1b068d9e1, hooks/guard_frozen.py), both Nov 8: a main merge with an unmarked dropped line. Incident folded in (coordinator 13:04 CST Nov 8, proposed step handoff-needs-lane-lint): lane override-plain-ask (session_013NEJKyzA8bkZSm147VHnke) handed #1463, #1513 and #1583 to runner 8 at 11:49 CST before linting them, and all three failed lint. Also cover the hand-off: refuse a lane's hand-off message to a batch runner for a PR whose live head has no passing `merge --lane-lint`. Sighting, lane lint-before-record-push 13:10 CST Nov 8 (routed by the coordinator 13:13 CST): check_comment_narration caught test comments that cite rulings and dates twice in one lane (#1898, #2032); only the lane lint caught them.
